invariants.name: BoundaryIntegrity
invariants.description: Architectures must maintain clear, non-porous boundaries. No cross-architecture artifact may blur, merge, or collapse boundaries.

invariants.name: SovereigntyPreservation
invariants.description: No architecture may impose its grammar, altitude, phenomenology, or internal logic on another.

invariants.name: ReversibilityOfContact
invariants.description: All interactions must be reversible, non-binding, and non-absorptive. Reflection is allowed; integration is not.

invariants.name: AltitudeNeutrality
invariants.description: Cross-architecture work must remain within A3–A5. No ascent into governance altitude; no descent into expressive activation.

invariants.name: DriftNeutrality
invariants.description: Collaboration must not induce identity drift, phenomenological flattening, or narrative contamination.

invariants.name: MembraneGuarantees
invariants.description: All cross-architecture artifacts must respect membrane constraints: non-coercive, non-directive, non-extractive, non-activating.

invariants.name: HumaneAccessibility
invariants.description: All shared artifacts must support neurodiverse pacing, multi-modal learning, and dignity-first grammar.

invariants.name: PhenomenologicalProtection
invariants.description: No architecture may flatten, override, or distort another’s phenomenological frame.

invariants.name: NeutralGrammar
invariants.description: Cross-architecture artifacts must use grammar that does not activate NDH solvers, ANIMA dynamics, or Mirror reflection loops.

invariants.name: StabilityEcologyAlignment
invariants.description: All components must declare stability tags and avoid destabilizing interactions across repos.

invariants.name: ReversibleCuriosity
invariants.description: Shared questions must not create persistent objects inside any architecture unless explicitly permitted.

invariants.name: NonActivationClause
invariants.description: Cross-architecture artifacts must remain external and non-activating relative to all runtime cores.
